notes.title: Patchnotes for Hotfix 12/18/2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39211036/5b21806d4e629fad11451acbb62267532a4b5575.jpg[/img]
This update fixes several player reported issues as well as a small numbers tweak.

- Fixed issue where movement input was failing on repeated plays of the game
- Fixed issue where colorblind mode was not affecting the settlement count bars
- Dropped the movement speed of Arat's Lion's Wrath (Q) to its intended value
